title: Adapt approved monitoring objectives to bounded Matter audience decisions
summary: Implement the approved monitoring handoff using existing Matter context, assessment, attention, explanation, replay and egress ports. The bounded adapter supports two saved-objective capture-only rehearsal and subsequent live-shadow inputs without claiming full civic acceptance or provider qualification.
in_scope: Exact host intent/component bindings and authorized evidence, per-audience result projection and baseline semantics.
Shared source interpretation, explicit objective/novelty judgments, silence/duplicate/correction/feedback behavior.
Version edits, stale-pending invalidation, fresh authorization and recorded replay/live parity under the agreed contract.
out_of_scope: StateCivics ORM/API/UI implementation, account/client ownership, event acquisition and actual delivery transport.
New JEV client, source retriever, database backend, dashboard service, custom writer or DIAT.
Issuing MAT-040 qualification or completing MAT-048/049/050 solely by passing this bounded adapter suite.
implementation: Consume the frozen MAT-081 DTO only after its decisions are settled. Reuse ContextDefinition/ContextService and independent purpose/objective/audience/responsibility/preference versions; bind exact intent/source/profile/question and applicable scope versions in assessment dependencies. Semantic reuse binds only consumed context components; a preference-only edit can refresh the output/currentness binding without reclassifying unchanged source facts or rerunning unchanged objective meaning.

Resolve the MAT-081/KS-1122 broad-scope mapping: keep host intent identity independent of civic matter identity and bind actual authorized candidate subjects when evaluating. Reuse existing registered candidate/absence scopes for newly eligible records that did not exist at activation; do not require a prior exact follow or manufacture a placeholder civic matter.

Validate host authority and exact source/context/audience/provider grants through MAT-072 at protected reads, packet rendering and dispatch, after I/O and before the host capture handoff. Reject workspace/client mismatch, unauthorized explanation reads and stale/revoked selectors; approved input prose is never permission.

Reuse source-linked packet/civic adapters where applicable, preserving source origin, authority uncertainty, coverage and exact citations. Keep source-only judgments free of private context; reuse the same source result for multiple objectives only under compatible permissions.

Compose private audience consequences through current rules/families, not organization names or keyword thresholds. Preserve unknown versus neutral and scope positions to their provision. Missing intent still permits authorized neutral exact-follow facts under the existing host path.

Compare against the actual applicable communicated/captured baseline and its exact conveyed content. Exact command retries/redelivery do not create new attempts/captures; distinguish another report from another occurrence and a real source correction from an analyst-error control.

Project existing attention treatment and reasons/citations/coverage/qualification/currentness plus capture-only allowed use. Relevance uncertainty, incomplete coverage, provider failure and access denial must not become a confident irrelevant result or a generic question for the user.

Register host-approved intent edits and feedback/dispositions against actual consumers. Refresh or withhold obsolete queued/in-flight results after edits, retirement, changed sources/profiles or revocation; preserve unaffected objectives, valid source facts and historical captures. Direct user controls take the host lane without model approval.

Preserve a linked correction of actual previously communicated unsupported information even where current positive relevance is low, subject to current authorization; already-handled/unchanged feedback must not silence a materially new deadline or correction forever.

Use one adapter for replay/live. Accept explicit knowledge cuts/context policy while current authorization/provider clocks stay real; deterministic parity uses the same frozen inputs and recorded judgments. Fresh JEV variability and exploratory quality are separate receipts.

Verify with independent synthetic positive/negative controls and provide a pinned adapter/conformance handoff for StateCivics KS-1126 actual two-saved-objective rehearsal. KS-1126 receiving acceptance is external host work, not a completion prerequisite for MAT-082; later KS-1127 consumes the same contract for live-feed shadow work. Preserve MAT-048/049 full prerequisites and MAT-040/042/050 gates for consequential production use.

Build on PR #26 civic_exports/civic_attention after merge, or keep this work stacked on it. MAT-081 freeze is the contract gate; KS-1121 is not a prerequisite for isolated Matter component conformance. The StateCivics KS-1124/1126 connection separately needs its study code and rebuilt Matter SDK image, current host controls and owned capture bindings.

acceptance.criterion: Two approved-objective fixture contexts share authorized source findings while retaining separate purpose/audience decisions and no cross-client leakage.
acceptance.verification: Run frozen synthetic contract fixtures: assert a shared finding digest, different justified positive/quiet treatments, personal/no-client support and denied foreign-client reads. This closes component conformance only; KS-1126 separately owns actual saved-objective and receiving/capture evidence and is not a completion prerequisite for MAT-082.

acceptance.criterion: The adapter consumes only exact approved/current context versions and refuses stale results before capture after a relevant edit or revocation.
acceptance.verification: Change intent/source/profile or permission while an attempt is queued/in flight and assert targeted invalidation/refresh/withholding, stable history and no effect on an unrelated objective.

acceptance.criterion: Duplicates, actual output baselines, feedback and corrections produce an explainable sequence with no fabricated outcome.
acceptance.verification: Behaviorally assert exact retry creates no extra attempt/capture, repeated evidence stays quiet, a genuinely new deadline survives handled feedback, a linked correction reaches the permitted audience and outcome-unknown remains unknown.

acceptance.criterion: Availability-ordered replay and incoming-live serialization use the same semantics without future-evidence or private-field leakage.
acceptance.verification: Replay the same approved revisions, available source sequence and recorded judgments through both modes; compare deterministic attention/capture traces, exercise a late source and currently known future deadline, and scan canary fields out of requests.

acceptance.criterion: Software conformance, actual live interpretations and qualification/production readiness remain separate in every receipt.
acceptance.verification: Verify explicit mode/use/qualification fields, failure/coverage reasons and current authority checks; retain fake/recorded/live distinctions and refuse consequential admission without its actual certificate and host authority.

tests: Two objectives under contrasting client contexts: useful positive plus justified silence, unchanged shared facts.
Personal objective and two intents for one client remain separate.
Unactivated draft, stale revision, queue/in-flight edit, source replacement, current permission revocation.
Duplicate/reprint, partial coverage, provider outage/budget exhaustion, missing or unknown prior outcome.
Already-handled feedback followed by a material deadline and correction of an actual prior capture.
Forbidden client rationale through explanation or semantic cache; future-available source withheld.
A new record/subject absent at intent activation becomes an eligible authorized candidate; an unrelated or ungranted new record stays out.
A cadence-only preference revision refreshes pending output guards without changing shared source facts; semantic reuse remains subject to current access and its consumed-component key.
risks: An all-quiet suite could look safe while suppressing useful positives; paired positives and correction controls are mandatory.
Context edits can either leak stale output or resend all history; targeted dependencies and observed-baseline semantics are required.
Capture-only experiments must not silently bypass qualification for actual production alerts.

reuse.application: Compose existing ports; add no parallel context store, permission engine, outbox or scheduler.
Reuse bounded source-first findings and limitations; do not relabel the earlier five-call experiment as saved-objective acceptance.

Host owns scope mapping, dispatcher, feedback transport and actual receiving/capture evidence. Synthetic adapter conformance can complete independently; connected receiving acceptance is explicitly required by the host ticket.

This is a bounded contributor to civic audience attention; reuse existing explanations rather than requiring all future neutral inspection/distribution work. Full civic qualification remains separate.

sources: Owner request, 2026-10-28: plan and ticket the saved-dashboard objectives -> JEV-powered Matter handoff for both availability-ordered timeline replay and incoming live data; planning only, DIAT excluded.

Owner authorization, 2026-10-30: use a real owned watchlist/item with refusal until authorized, continue through MAT-081 freeze and MAT-082; broaden researched illustrative use cases without expanding the first two-objective capture-only slice.

evidence: Bounded MAT-082 component implementation: optional statecivics_monitoring composes actual access/context, prepared-packet, committed-budget, durable-execution and current-attention services against frozen monitoring-handoff/1.0.0. No replacement infrastructure or StateCivics runtime changes.

24 distinct component test methods have passing receipts across bounded segments and affected-case reruns. Includes actual two-audience positive/quiet decisions, owned-target refusal, queued/in-flight grant withdrawal, exact recovery past deadline, observed-baseline duplicate/correction checks, scoped handled/new-deadline behavior, in-flight preference semantic reuse, new candidate admission, recorded replay/live parity and future-source canary exclusion. See docs/validation/dashboard-matter-handoff.md and external run manifest for limits and failed checkpoints.

179 contract tests and two existing availability/candidate-watch regressions passed. Current wheel module/schema/question/refusal smoke passed outside checkout; render/check, repository validation and whitespace checks passed. The separate installed walkthrough-schema failure is not cleared and the full repository/stress suite was not rerun.

Two-pass independent reviews completed for all selected files; confirmed findings were corrected and affected cases rerun. Unpinned-position warnings were manually checked; no separate clean independent verdict after final corrections is claimed.

All new executor responses and host projections are authored synthetic conformance. Zero live JEV calls, no actual StateCivics receiving run or provider qualification. KS-1122/1124/1126 mapping/control/SDK and receiving work, wider MAT-048/049 and MAT-040 human-reviewed qualification remain separate.
